external_dataset.design: independent single-institute NSCLC cohort; Affymetrix HG-U133 Plus 2.0
external_dataset.excluded_histology: large-cell carcinoma (not part of LUAD/LUSC target)

protocol.external_validation: all adeno/squamous GSE37745 samples, evaluated once
protocol.feature_availability_filter: GPL570 mapping only; no external outcome used
protocol.primary_normalization: within-sample percentile ranks; independent per sample
protocol.training_selection: TCGA training partition only, inner 5-fold CV

sensitivity_cohort_zscore.note: External feature-wise z-scores use the unlabeled external cohort distribution.
